notice: All organisations, equipment and procedures below are authored fictional examples. These are search test notes, not real operating instructions.

sources.title: Camera returns
sources.text:
If a borrowed camera is damaged, take photographs of the damage and label the kit before asking the equipment coordinator to inspect it. Do not return it to the available shelf.

A working camera can be checked back in after its battery, lens cap and carry bag have been counted. Record any missing item in the return note.

sources.title: Projector setup
sources.text:
A projector that shows no picture should first be checked for a loose video cable and the selected input. If neither fixes the picture, stop the setup and contact the room technician.

A replacement projector may be borrowed from the labelled spare shelf. Record the spare unit number and return it to that shelf after the session.

sources.title: Workshop room bookings
sources.text:
Cancel a workshop room reservation by emailing the room coordinator before noon on the previous working day. Include the booking reference and session date.

The east workshop has twelve seats. A larger session needs a different room; adding chairs to the doorway is not allowed in this fictional venue.

sources.title: Ticket refunds: archived note
sources.text:
The archived ticket note says attendees can request a refund up to twenty-four hours before the session. This note has been superseded; preserve it when investigating an older booking.

The archived note does not describe how to cancel a room reservation or report damaged equipment.

sources.title: Ticket refunds: current note
sources.text:
The current ticket note allows refund requests until three working days before a session. Send the ticket reference to the workshop organiser. It replaces the archived twenty-four-hour rule.

An organiser may transfer a ticket to another named attendee after recording the original and new names. This is a ticket change, not a refund.

sources.title: Garden workshop materials
sources.text:
Use the blue tray for seeds and the green tray for watering supplies. Ask the garden lead before taking tools from the locked cupboard.

Return borrowed hand tools after brushing away soil and counting them against the tool list. Note a missing tool before closing the workshop.
